newsitem.title: ITALY: Lost wallet puts escaped prisoner back behind bars.
newsitem.headline: Lost wallet puts escaped prisoner back behind bars.

text.p: An escaped Italian prisoner was back behind bars on Tuesday after he lost his wallet and police telephoned him to come and collect it.

Luigi De Chirico, 36, slipped away from a company where he was allowed to work during a four-month prison sentence in the central town of Terni, but lost his wallet containing identity papers and his cellphone number.
A police officer called De Chirico on his cellphone and arrested him when he arrived -- on a stolen moped -- to pick up the wallet. De Chirico now faces fresh charges of evading jail and theft.
